configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: cd backend && set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

configurations.name: mobile
runtimeArgs: cd mobile && ADB=$(command -v adb || echo $HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb); $ADB reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=${EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL:-http://localhost:8000} exec npx expo start --port 8081
